report_card.title: CSR
report_card.subtitle: Claim Settlement Ratio
report_card.description: CSR shows the percentage of eligible claims that an insurer settles during a given period. A higher ratio generally indicates a strong claim settlement track record.

report_card.title: ICR
report_card.subtitle: Incurred Claim Ratio
report_card.description: ICR indicates the proportion of premium earned that an insurer spends on settling claims. It provides an overview of the insurer's claims experience.

report_card.title: COMPLAINT VOLUME
report_card.subtitle: Complaints per 10,000 Claims
report_card.description: Complaint volume indicates the number of complaints received in relation to the number of claims handled. It helps provide context about the customer claim experience.
